description: Object /tests (spec 19.15, 19.20): the batch test run of lw test as a task-streamed method; the protocol-10 test request stays as its v0 alias. Step 5m (spec 19.15 Tests, 19.20 Tests/1) adds the editor's discover (part B1), run_cases, prepare_debug (task-streamed), collect and result (part B2) with their handlers; its results signal, which needs no handler, is declared here from part 0.

run.description: Build the profile (unless no_build), then run its registered tests (lw test [<profile>] [--no-build] [--junit <file>] [-- <args>]).

profile.description: The profile (absent: the active one), resolved as the in-process command resolves it.

interactive.description: The client can ask the user (a terminal); without it a missing profile is refused, never onboarded.

command.description: The command name the task's lines quote (lw build, ...).

extra.description: Arguments passed to the test runner (after --).

junit.description: Write JUnit XML to this path.

no_build.description: Run against the existing build (--no-build, spec 16.16): nothing configured, built or deployed; the plan's no-build checks refuse an unconfigured unit or an unbuilt executable before any step.

result.description: The test run's end and its structured results.

steps.description: The test steps run, in order (empty: the profile has no tests). Per-case results come later as an optional field.

status.description: passed (exit code 0) or failed. Clients show an unknown status as failed.

discover.description: Discover the tests of the active profile's units (spec 19.15 Tests) in the caller's environment, updating loomworks.view.Tests/1: each unit in project-key order, a unit with nothing to probe getting its view state and a unit whose tree is current not probed again unless force; a probe holds the unit's build-directory lock (behind a task of the daemon it waits; a holder in another process fails that unit, its state error). A unit's failure does not end the task; a cancel stops between units and at a probe's programs (the view stays stale). The view's update precedes done.

force.description: Probe units whose tree is current too.

tests.description: The number of tests of the profile's units after discovery (the discovered entries no other entry is the parent of: cases, and targets without cases).

failed.description: The number of units whose discovery failed (their view state error).

run_cases.description: Run test nodes of the active profile (spec 19.15 Tests): the build-directory locks of the selection's units (waiting behind another Tests/1 task of the same directory, failing fast against another process), unless no_build the build of the selection's targets, then one test step per program under its structured harness, each with its own results file, every step even after one failed. Its per-case progress is the results signal; its end the view update. A stale or non-runnable node is refused before acceptance.

select.description: The nodes to run (runnable view nodes): a target node runs its program whole, a suite or test node with a filter. Absent: every runnable node of every discovered unit of the profile.

extra.description: Arguments appended to every test step's program.

result.description: The run's end: every case it reported, in report order, and their counts (a program whose exit status is its only result is one case).

discovery_error.description: Present when a covered unit's discovery failed: why.

prepare_debug.description: Prepare debugging one test node (spec 19.15 Tests, 19.16 Tests): the locks and build of a run_cases of that node (released when the task ends), then the debug spec of the test step run_cases would have run (its program, arguments, filter and results option, working directory and environment) with the debug languages and adapters resolved, and a prepared token for collect. The client runs the program under its debugger.

select.description: The one runnable node (an object, not an array).

result.description: The preparation's end: on success the debug spec and the prepared token.

prepared.description: Opaque; the calling connection's, for collect.

collect.description: After a prepared test debug session: parse the results file its program wrote, record its cases as the nodes' last results (the results signal and the view update follow), remove the file and drop the token. Refused for a token this connection does not hold (already collected, or of a closed connection).

cases.description: The cases recorded (empty when the program wrote no results).

result.description: A node's last result in this daemon session with its output and error locations (spec 19.15 Tests). A node with no last result answers only id and an empty errors; a stale id is refused.

output.description: Its captured output: at most its last 256 KiB.

truncated.description: output was cut to its end.

results.description: Per-case progress of a running run_cases (any client's), batched at most about 4 per second per run, and the cases a collect recorded (task_id absent). A delta on top of loomworks.view.Tests/1, never initial: on a seq gap or a new session generation a client calls view.Tests/1.get, whose state already includes every change results carried. A run's last results precedes the view update that ends it. The batch run sends none.

task_id.description: The run_cases task; absent for a collect.

cases.description: The cases whose status changed since the previous results of this run, each with its current status.
